description: Per-store descriptor rules for the `mcc` basis (2026-10-11). By default a record's rows are the dataset rows whose merchant descriptor contains the record's name on word boundaries (tokens in order, punctuation and spaces optional; see derivePattern in tools/catalog-pipeline/src/merchants/mcc.ts). An entry replaces that pattern (`patterns`, regular expressions on the upper-case, space-normalised descriptor), drops rows of other businesses that share the name (`excludes`), refuses the data's category for the store (`veto`, with the reason) or leaves the record unmatched (`skip`, a name that is a common word). Evidence-matching rules of the eval pipeline, not store configs in the extension.

ebay-us.veto: eBay is an online marketplace of third-party sellers by its own pages; the department-store code (5311) is the platform's acquiring code, not a full-line department store, and the issuers' department-store definitions name full-line stores (coordinator rule 4: the store's own pages veto). For Evan.
